report.answer: A reproducible asset-only package is bit-for-bit identical specified artifacts. The actual Windows archive and a fresh Linux zlib-ng 2.2.4 rebuild match at e0c290566d46e27e36bc8674556c22b8cc30f75fd2ddb67bfe4ee530bcf3cabf. Unpinned system zlib and CRLF-without-normalisation both differ. Order, mtimes, separators, CRLF/LF, Unicode composition, and path case each change stored-ZIP bytes in isolation. Exact case is identity: NFC-normalise paths but reject casefold collisions. ZIP_STORED is the lower-dependency option when compression is unnecessary.

minimal_recipe.compression: ZIP_STORED; alternatively pin and attest one compressor implementation and its parameters
minimal_recipe.content: normalize declared UTF-8 text extensions CRLF and CR to LF; preserve binary bytes
minimal_recipe.metadata: ZIP epoch 1980-01-01 00:00:00, create_system=3, fixed 0644/0755 modes, no extras or comments
minimal_recipe.path: relative UTF-8 NFC, forward slash separators, exact case, reject duplicate and casefold-colliding names
minimal_recipe.selection: explicit manifest/allowlist; omit VCS metadata, output trees, caches, and unrelated files
